title: Reject Return
label: TIKTOK SHOP · API REFERENCE
subtitle: Updated 2026-10-13
html:
Path: /return_refund/202606/returns/{return_id}/reject

Method: [POST]

Function Description

Use this API to reject a buyer's refund-only, return-and-refund, or replacement request, or to offer a partial refund after the package is received. The valid decision depends on the current request type and status. Before calling this API, make sure the request is still awaiting the seller action that matches the decision you send.

Common Parameters

For common parameters, refer to How to call TikTok Shop APIs - Common Parameters

Properties Location Type Require Sample Properties description
shop_cipher query string Y GCP_XF90igAAAABh00qsWgtvOiGFNqyubMt3 Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response.
Get by API Get Authorization Shop
content-type header string Y application/json Allowed type: application/json

Request Path Parameters

Properties Type Require Sample Properties description
return_id string Y 4035319218955782461 The unique identifier of the return request to be rejected by the seller.

Request Query Parameters

Properties Type Require Sample Properties description
app_key string Y 38abcd Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.
sign string Y 5361235029d141222525e303d742f9e38aea052d10896d3197ab9d6233730b8c Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.
timestamp int Y 1623812664 Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.
idempotency_key string N 40b456b1-78e7-412d-9fe6-82181496e1bd A unique value generated by the client that the server uses to recognize repeated requests. Generate a collision-resistant value, such as a UUID, and reuse the same value when retrying the same request. If omitted, the server generates a key for the request; callers that need idempotent retries should provide and reuse their own key. Maximum length: 255 characters.

Request Body Parameters

Properties Type Require Sample Properties description
decision string Y REJECT_RECEIVED_PACKAGE Seller's decision for the request, available values:
  • REJECT_REFUND: seller reject a refund-only request
  • REJECT_RETURN: seller reject the initial return-and-refund request
  • REJECT_RECEIVED_PACKAGE: seller reject return-and-refund request after the buyer has already shipped or handed over the item.
  • REJECT_REPLACEMENT: seller reject replacement request
  • OFFER_PARTIAL_REFUND_AFTER_RECEIVING_PKG: seller offer partial refund regarding to the package item quality check | reject_reason |string |Y |seller_reject_apply_package_has_not_exceeded_estimated_delivery_time |Seller's reason for rejecting the aftersales request. For OFFER_PARTIAL_REFUND_AFTER_RECEIVING_PKG, first call Get Review Decision (GET /return_refund/202606/review_decision) for the same aftersales request: pass this request's return_id as return_or_cancel_id and set check_decisions to OFFER_PARTIAL_REFUND_AFTER_RECEIVING_PKG. In the response, select the data.line_items[] entry for the affected return line item, then select its decisions[] entry whose decision is OFFER_PARTIAL_REFUND_AFTER_RECEIVING_PKG, and submit one of that decision's available_reject_reasons[].name values in this field. For other decisions, use the Get Decision Eligibility endpoint to retrieve the currently available rejection options for the same request and submit the returned rejection reason name. Note: Available decisions and rejection reasons depend on the current request status, so retrieve eligibility again before calling this API. | comment |string |N |I have reached an agreement with the buyer |Seller's comment about the rejection decision. For OFFER_PARTIAL_REFUND_AFTER_RECEIVING_PKG, the comment must not exceed 500 characters. | images |[]object |N | |Images provided by the seller to support the decision. For OFFER_PARTIAL_REFUND_AFTER_RECEIVING_PKG, a maximum of 6 images is allowed. | ^image_id |string |Y |tos-maliva-i-o3syd03w52-us/57a1c8908fe74572861ea5e50887d8d1 |Image URI obtained from the Upload Product Image API. | ^mime_type |string |N |image/png |MIME type. | ^height |int |N |200 |Image height Units: px | ^width |int |N |200 |Image width Units: px | partial_refund_amount |object |N | |Partial refund amount and currency. Required when decision is OFFER_PARTIAL_REFUND_AFTER_RECEIVING_PKG. | ^partial_refund_total |string |N |4.66 |Partial refund amount. When decision is OFFER_PARTIAL_REFUND_AFTER_RECEIVING_PKG, this field is required and must be a numeric string representing an amount greater than 0. | ^currency |string |N |USD |Currency of the partial refund amount. When decision is OFFER_PARTIAL_REFUND_AFTER_RECEIVING_PKG, this field is required and must match the return order's currency. |

Request Sample

Query

https://open-api.tiktokglobalshop.com/return_refund/202606/returns/4035319218955782461/reject?app_key=123abc&sign=5361235029d141222525e303d742f9e38aea052d10896d3197ab9d6233730b8c&timestamp=1625484268&shop_cipher=ROW_RHkDDABBAAB8tKAVoAqsMTjsQZFLyNfY&idempotency_key=40b456b1-78e7-412d-9fe6-82181496e1bd

Body

{"decision":"REJECT_RECEIVED_PACKAGE","reject_reason":"seller_reject_apply_package_has_not_exceeded_estimated_delivery_time","comment":"I have reached an agreement with the buyer","images":[{"image_id":"tos-maliva-i-o3syd03w52-us/57a1c8908fe74572861ea5e50887d8d1","mime_type":"image/png","height":200,"width":200}],"partial_refund_amount":{"partial_refund_total":"4.66","currency":"USD"}}
